p-implement-promise-all.prelude:
// Resolves with v after ms milliseconds (the tests use fake timers).
const later = <T,>(v: T, ms: number) => new Promise<T>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(v), ms));

p-a-typed-event-emitter.prelude:
// The events the tests use, with their payload types.
type RunEvents = { step: { id: string; name: string }; done: { ok: boolean } };

p-bounded-async-queue-with-backpressure.prelude:
// Waits one turn of the event loop.
const tick = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
